def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state)
    m = len(state[0])
    result = [[0]*m for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            if i % 2 == 0:  # even row: E/W neighborhood
                # Sum of left, self, right (boundary = 0)
                left = state[i][j-1] if j > 0 else 0
                right = state[i][j+1] if j < m-1 else 0
                result[i][j] = (left + state[i][j] + right) % 3
            else:  # odd row: N/S neighborhood
                # Sum of north, self, south (boundary = 0)
                north = state[i-1][j] if i > 0 else 0
                south = state[i+1][j] if i < n-1 else 0
                result[i][j] = (north + state[i][j] + south) % 3
    return result
